messages:
Maria: Heads-up: proposing webinar topic "Practical Inference Economics" — tradeoffs between latency, cost, and reliability. Need final abstract + speakers today.

Sam: solid. need a 1-line promo headline.

Eugene: "Cut inference spend, keep latency low" ?

Maria: Posting two abstract drafts.

Maria: Abstract A: "Practical tactics to reduce LLM inference costs while preserving latency and output quality. We'll cover batching, KV caching, model-variant routing, and show benchmark results plus a short Q&A. Also: how to make spend predictable for platform buyers."

Maria: Abstract B: "Serving LLMs in production: policy-driven routing, caching, and fallback design to balance cost and SLAs. Includes benchmark takeaways and a checklist to apply immediately."

Tara: I prefer A — more actionable.

Alex: A is better for demand. Can we add enterprise benefit language (reserved capacity/SLA)?

Maria: Added: "...and controls to make spend predictable (SLA/reserved capacity guidance)."

Sam: Proposed speakers: Maria host, Eugene runtime+demo, Priya customer case (8m), Alex 5m offer. Agree?

Priya: Confirmed — I can present anonymized metrics.

dev-bot: calendar: rehearsal Thu 2026-04-02 11:00 PDT. Invite posted to #webinar-rehearsals. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Draft rehearsal checklist:
- 30m slide run-through
- 20m live demo failover test
- 10m AV + captions check

Sam: I'll moderate chat and triage Qs. Alex captures demo interest leads.

Alex: I'll own registration form + HubSpot mapping. Proposed fields: name, email, company, role, tokens/day, interest (POC/pricing/trial), consent, utm.

Tara: Legal copy: "We'll use this to follow up about Redwood Inference." Add retention note.

Alex: Routing plan: HubSpot campaign "webinar-inference-2026-q2"; SFDC same. Region routing: NA->na-sales@redwood, EU->eu-sales@redwood, APAC->apac-sales@redwood via workflow.

Sam: Tag product interest: hosted/dedicated/private for AE routing.

Maria: Promo blurb (<=200 chars): "Webinar: Practical Inference Economics — tactics and benchmarks to cut LLM inference costs without sacrificing latency or reliability. Wed Apr 9, 10am PT. Register: <link>"

Design-team: Need hero image + 30s demo GIF. Deadline Tue EOD.

Design-team: On it — will deliver hero + GIF by Tue EOD. :sparkles:

Eugene: Draft run-of-show — comments welcome.

Maria: Run-of-show draft:
10:00 Intro (Maria) — 3m
10:03 Why inference economics matters (Eugene) — 7m
10:10 Customer case (Priya) — 8m
10:18 Live benchmark demo + failover (Eugene & Maria) — 12m
10:30 Controls & routing (Sam) — 6m
10:36 Sales TL;DR + offer (Alex) — 4m
10:40 Live Q&A — 15m
10:55 Wrap + survey link (Maria) — 5m

Alex: Offer suggestion: 2-week Dedicated eval credits + optional eng office hour. A/B test with promo code vs. office hour.

Sam: We'll randomize CTAs on thank-you page via URL param and track conversions in HubSpot.

Maria: Action items:
- Maria: finalize abstract + reg copy (today)
- Design: hero + GIF (Tue EOD)
- Eugene: benchmark slides + demo script (for rehearsal)
- Priya: customer slides + anonymized metrics (Thu)
- Sam: routing workflows + chat plan (Mon)
- Alex: HubSpot/SFDC campaign + offer config (Mon)

Tara: Also need embargoed benchmark snapshot and press list — target next week.

Maria: I'll prep the embargoed snapshot.

Sam: :white_check_mark: routing workflow started
Eugene: :white_check_mark: initial slides uploaded
Alex: :white_check_mark: campaign skeleton created
Priya: :white_check_mark: case slides ready
Design-team: :white_check_mark: creative in progress

Maria: Thanks — react with :white_check_mark: when tasks are done. Will post reg link when live. Closing thread.
